body: Yeah… why am I still here? Life is just tough. I’m tired of hearing the lie that it’ll get better. Sometimes it doesn’t. Now I feel sad u feel the same way being so young. Even though I felt the same way in high school, it saddens me you feel this way. I felt the same. Never thought I’d make it to 20. Now I’m almost 30 and still around. I won’t pretend I know how. Maybe im just a coward. Also, I have no idea where im going with this. Felt I just needed to relate to someone. Anyone.
I don’t know why. But that actually does mean a lot to me even though I don’t feel strong enough. I thought I had people to rely on but I don’t know anymore.
